summary: Native partial chronology through s0095 on draft #5488 post-editorial apply. Prior s0037–s0046 decisions preserved. Six coherent groups reviewed: early Jin mourning policy (s0047–s0056), Wen/Zhou retrospectives (s0057–s0073), Taishi 4 dowager funeral (s0066–s0071), post-funeral policy (s0074–s0086), Eastern Jin Mu→Ai debate (s0087–s0094), 寧康二年閏月 rule (s0095). Owner holds unchanged for claim-11/12 intervals and claim-18 funeral dating, now extended for claim-7, claim-20/24, claim-35. Not chapter approval.
